subject: Multi-entity vendor — bank forms, PO mapping and remit encoding
messages:
From: Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@celestial.tech>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Celestial Tech — bank docs and entity mapping attached

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Per our conversation, attaching the following for vendor onboarding:
- bank_letter_Celestial_20260620.pdf (bank-signed letter with routing/account)
- W9_Celestial_20260620.pdf (completed W-9)
- vendor_entity_matrix.xlsx (maps our billing entities to operating subsidiaries)

Two quick notes:
1) We have three legal entities in scope for Redwood purchases — ParentCo, Celestial US LLC (ACH), and Celestial WireOps (wiring only). The matrix indicates which invoices should be routed to which legal entity and PO prefix.
2) For remittance, our accounting system expects a structured remit string: "ENTITY|INVOICE_REF|PO_PREFIX" in the remitter field when available. If Redwood's AP system can't accept structured strings, please confirm a fallback.

Can you confirm receipt and next steps so we can schedule the first invoice/PO mapping? We can also start the DocuSign verification if preferred.

Thanks,
Samantha Lopez
Director, Vendor Finance
Celestial Tech
[s.lopez@celestial.tech]

Attachments: bank_letter_Celestial_20260620.pdf, W9_Celestial_20260620.pdf, vendor_entity_matrix.xlsx

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@celestial.tech>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Celestial Tech — bank docs and entity mapping attached

Hi Samantha — thanks, I have the files. Quick read-through below and next steps:

Received items: bank letter + W-9 + entity matrix (good).
Open items for AP / procurement before first pay run:
- Which currency and rails per entity? (matrix shows USD for all; confirm if any GBP/EUR).
- Preferred remitter field format: we can support a structured string in our tile-based remit field, but the exact delimiter/length matters for downstream ERPs. Your suggested format (ENTITY|INVOICE_REF|PO_PREFIX) is fine — please confirm max lengths per element.
- DocuSign verification: we prefer the bank-attestation DocuSign so AP can reconcile micro-deposits. Please sign the bank verification role so we can trigger micro-deposit verification.

For internal clarity, we'll adopt this flow:
1) I will create the vendor record in the portal with the primary payee as Celestial US LLC (ACH) and a secondary wiring profile for ParentCo (wires only).
2) AP (cc'd) will review the entity matrix and confirm PO prefix mapping.
3) We will send a micro-deposit to the ACH account and ask you to confirm amounts in the DocuSign verification. Wires will require bank-letter verification only.

Sample remit examples we can accept in the remitter field:
- Structured: "CEUS|INV-2026-459|PO-RED-0123"
- Fallback (if upstream truncates): use plain invoice number and add "(Celestial)" in the description.

I've attached our internal vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf here for your reference. Can you confirm: (A) maximum permitted length for each segment of your structured string, (B) whether any entity requires a VAT/Tax ID to appear on the remit line, and (C) whether you want invoices to reference the Purchase Order prefix exactly as mapped.

I'll loop AP after you confirm and share the DocuSign link.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Vendor Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@celestial.tech>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Celestial Tech — bank docs and entity mapping attached

Hi Nikhil — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below and forwarding the signed bank letter excerpt for visibility.

A) Max lengths: ENTITY = 12 chars, INVOICE_REF = 24 chars, PO_PREFIX = 10 chars. If a segment exceeds the limit, truncate on the right.
B) VAT/Tax ID: ParentCo (for wires) requires the US EIN to be present on the remitter line when wires are initiated. ACH does not require EIN on remit.
C) PO prefix: yes, please use the PO prefix exactly as in the matrix.

Mapping summary (copied from vendor_entity_matrix.xlsx):
- PO prefix RED-US = Celestial US LLC (ACH) — bank account A123456 (ACH)
- PO prefix RED-PARENT = ParentCo (Wires) — bank account W-998877 (Wires only)
- PO prefix RED-OEM = Celestial WireOps (Wires preferred for vendor rebates)

We signed the bank attestation page and uploaded to DocuSign. Expect a DocuSign notification shortly.

On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 09:14 AM Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@celestial.tech> wrote:

Thanks,
Samantha
